```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7)
```

# 00. SETUP

```{r s00}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Options
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13))
status_colors <- c(
  "Listed (6.1 Table 1)" = "#2a78d6",
  "Listed (6.1 text, not Table 1)" = "#1baf7a",
  "Mentioned elsewhere" = "#eb6834",
  "Missing" = "#eda100"
)
status_shapes <- c(
  "Listed (6.1 Table 1)" = 16,
  "Listed (6.1 text, not Table 1)" = 15,
  "Mentioned elsewhere" = 17,
  "Missing" = 18
)
```

# H3. FOREST PLOT OF GROUPED TERMS (POOLED EMERGENT-1/2/3)

```{r h3_figure}
################################################################################
# H3. Forest plot: grouped terms, risk difference, label status
################################################################################

# Grouped terms with label status (clinical groups only; label-footnote groups excluded)
h3_df <- read_excel("data/h3_screen_results.xlsx", sheet = "group") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(group, "^Label:")) %>%
  mutate(
    label_status = factor(label_status, levels = names(status_colors)),
    group_label = paste0(group, "  (", round(pct_active, 1), "% vs ", round(pct_placebo, 1), "%)"),
    group_label = fct_reorder(group_label, rd_pct)
  )
print(select(h3_df, group, label_status, pct_active, pct_placebo, rd_pct, rd_lo_pct, rd_hi_pct))

h3_figure_forest <- ggplot(h3_df, aes(x = rd_pct, y = group_label, colour = label_status, shape = label_status)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = rd_lo_pct, xmax = rd_hi_pct), height = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "US label status") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = status_shapes, drop = FALSE, name = "US label status") +
  labs(
    x = "Risk difference, Cobenfy minus placebo (percentage points, MH 95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Grouped adverse events, pooled 5-week placebo-controlled trials",
    subtitle = "EMERGENT-1/2/3, ClinicalTrials.gov results; trials not reporting a term omitted for that term"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical", plot.title.position = "plot")
print(h3_figure_forest)
```

# H4. FAERS REPORTING ODDS RATIOS (GROUPED TERMS)

```{r h4_figure}
################################################################################
# H4. Forest plot: FAERS ROR vs newer antipsychotics, grouped terms
################################################################################

h4_df <- read_excel("data/h4_faers_results.xlsx", sheet = "faers") %>%
  filter(level == "group", !str_detect(event, "^Label:"), a_newer >= 3, c_newer >= 1) %>%
  left_join(
    read_excel("data/clean_trials.xlsx", sheet = "term_groups") %>%
      left_join(read_excel("data/clean_trials.xlsx", sheet = "label_status"), by = "meddra_pt") %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        label_status = case_when(
          any(label_status == "Listed (6.1 Table 1)") ~ "Listed (6.1 Table 1)",
          any(label_status == "Listed (6.1 text, not Table 1)") ~ "Listed (6.1 text, not Table 1)",
          any(str_detect(label_status, "Mentioned")) ~ "Mentioned elsewhere",
          TRUE ~ "Missing"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("event" = "group")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_status = factor(label_status, levels = names(status_colors)),
    event_label = paste0(event, "  (n = ", a_newer, ")"),
    event_label = fct_reorder(event_label, ror_newer)
  )
print(select(h4_df, event, label_status, a_newer, ror_newer, ror_lo_newer, ror_hi_newer, ror_lo_newer_hcp, confirmed_faers))

h4_figure_forest <- ggplot(h4_df, aes(x = ror_newer, y = event_label, colour = label_status, shape = label_status)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ror_lo_newer, xmax = ror_hi_newer), height = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "US label status") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = status_shapes, drop = FALSE, name = "US label status") +
  labs(
    x = "ROR vs lumateperone, brexpiprazole, cariprazine (95% CI, log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "FAERS 2024Q3-2026Q3, deduplicated, Cobenfy as suspect drug",
    subtitle = "n = Cobenfy reports with the event; groups with at least 3 Cobenfy and 1 comparator report"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical", plot.title.position = "plot")
print(h4_figure_forest)
```
